intro: The KredFlow pitch runs on three words: automated, accurate, easy. The disclosure pages run on different words. This review shows where the two disagree.
It is a web platform with two modes: automatic, where the models execute according to your settings, and manual, where you confirm each entry yourself. Entry costs US$250 and includes a demo.

We read every public page - the pricing notes, the restriction lists, the support claims and the disclosures - and scored the platform on ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The verdict below is our own.

faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.a: The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.
